title: Inventor B: representation change gives only constant factors (orbit rho, volcano ascent)
question: Inventor B (ECDLP-43, representation change): no asymptotic gain over Pollard rho. B1 automorphism-orbit rho (j=0 |Aut|=6, j=1728 |Aut|=4) recovers k in 450/450 runs, r <= 2^36; fitted exponents 0.44-0.49 (CIs contain or nearly contain 0.5); pooled rho/orbit ratio 1.45 [1.14,1.88] (j=0, below pre-registered 1.15 threshold) and 2.62 [2.15,3.17] (j=1728, inflated by heavy-tailed rho baseline 2-3x above textbook). Known technique (constant sqrt|Aut|). B2 2-isogeny volcano ascent to j=0 then B1: 150/150, isogeny evaluations ~ a^1.86 (polylog); pre-registered rule printed "asymptotic improvement" but this is a false positive from additive overhead shrinking 60%->3%; medians indicate exponent 1/2, constant ~2-2.5; applies only to curves isogenous to j=0 (fraction ~ p^-0.47 [-0.58,-0.38]); equivalent in kind to Jao-Miller-Venkatesan / Galbraith volcano climbing. Isogeny-pooled, twist-pooled and other curve models rejected on paper (preserve r and group structure).
rationale: Strategic correction: constructive algorithm candidates benchmarked vs rho.
